description: Add a step to the sequence. `wait_days` is the gap BEFORE this step, so the first touch is wait_days 0 and "3 days later" is wait_days 3 on the NEXT step. Omit step_index to append. Pass `variant` to write the copy in the same call — a step with no variant cannot be armed. ⚠️ Phase 4 sends EMAIL ONLY: kind 'call'/'manual' is refused with 422, because such a step would sit in your sequence doing nothing. Returns the WHOLE campaign, since inserting a step shifts every later step's cumulative day_offset. Requires draft or paused.

kind.description: Default 'email'. The other two are modelled but not executed yet (422).

step_index.description: Explicit position. Omit to append after the current last step.

variant.description: The step's copy, created in the same transaction.

subject_template.description: 🔴 LEAVE EMPTY ON FOLLOW-UP STEPS. An empty subject means CONTINUE THE THREAD: the Subject header is omitted and the message replies into the lead's existing thread. A non-empty subject starts a NEW thread. Do not invent a subject to fill this in — that breaks threading on every sequence and nothing errors.

wait_days.description: Days to wait BEFORE this step (0-365).

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_add_step
